basis: COFS is defined by brain malformations/developmental impairment, microphthalmia and skeletal deformities/contractures; supplied phenotypes support all three.
Wart-like benign epithelial papilloma; dermatologic is the best fit, but the definition specifies no anatomical site. HPV infection is not established.
Non-endocrine ovarian stromal neoplasm. Supplied pleural and other annotations reflect selected syndromic presentations; they do not establish common direct extraovarian damage.
Skeletal and CNS malformations define AFND; cleft palate 80-99% supports oral involvement. Hypopituitarism 2/3 supports endocrine dysfunction; ocular abnormalities omitted by cap.
Endometrial proliferation affects a reproductive organ outside the axes; hormonal stimulation does not make the lesion an endocrine disease.
Testicular germ cell tumour affects a reproductive organ; it is not a tumour of gonadal hormone-producing cells. No common direct extraorgan damage established.
Ovarian sex cord-stromal tumour involves Sertoli/Leydig endocrine tissue and may produce sex hormones; no additional organ damage established across the group.
Psychiatric umbrella has no axis. Cognitive subtypes do not establish neurologic damage in most patients across the group.
Isolated ocular coloboma/microphthalmia defines the disease. Renal reflux and ventriculomegaly have unspecified frequencies and do not establish common extraocular damage.
Mediastinal origin lies outside the specified axes; thoracic location alone does not establish lung, airway, pleural or cardiovascular occupation or damage.
